quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #5
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead ends.
You must turn right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: Large vehicles have blind spots that can extend 200 feet directly behind them.

options.text: TRUE
FALSE

questions.explanation: Large vehicles have blind spots that extend 200 feet behind them. Do not tailgate large vehicles. The driver cannot see you there.

questions.question: Which statement about railroad crossings is true?

options.text: It is illegal to drive around lowered crossing gates.
You must stop if a flagger tells you to stop at a railroad crossing.
Not all railroad crossings have flashing red lights and gates.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Stop at railroad crossings when a flagger directs you or when you see stop signs or warning lights and gates. Not all crossings have these devices. It is against the law to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: When must you stop for a school bus?

options.text: When it is parked on the road shoulder with no one in it.
When it approaches you, even if its lights are not flashing.
When you are on a two-lane highway and its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are on a two-lane highway and its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when a school bus displays flashing red lights while picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic from both directions must stop while the red lights are flashing or the stop arm is extended.

questions.question: How does alcohol affect your reflexes and judgment?

options.text: Beer affects you less than wine.
Wine affects you less than beer.
Hard ciders and mixed drinks affect you more.
It depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.correctAnswerText: It depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.
questions.explanation: Any type of alcohol harms your reflexes and judgment. The type of drink does not matter. Only the amount of alcohol in your bloodstream matters.

questions.question: What should you do if you have a tire blowout?

options.text: Release the gas pedal.
Do not brake immediately.
Slow down gradually and pull off the road.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: If you have a tire blowout, release the gas and do not brake right away. Slow down gradually, then gently apply the brakes and pull off the road.

questions.question: When two cars arrive at an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car on the right.
The car on the left.
The car whose driver honks first.
The car traveling faster.

questions.explanation: At an intersection with no traffic control, you must yield to a vehicle approaching from the right.

questions.question: In fog, should you use high beam headlights to see better?

options.text: True
False

questions.explanation: Do not use high beams in fog. Use low beam headlights or fog lights instead.

questions.question: Is it good to turn your head and check your blind spot before changing lanes or merging?

options.text: No, it is a bad habit.
Yes, it is a good habit.
No, it is unnecessary.
No, not if you use the rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, it is a good habit.
questions.explanation: Always check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder before changing lanes. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: Which statement about drowsy drivers is true?

options.text: They should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
They can drive so poorly that they seem drunk.
They can stay alert by opening a window and turning up the radio.
Drowsiness mainly affects older drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: They can drive so poorly that they seem drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive so poorly that they appear to be drunk. Opening a window, turning on the radio, or drinking coffee is not enough to keep a drowsy driver alert.

questions.question: Must drivers always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road?

options.text: TRUE
FALSE

questions.explanation: You must always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road, no matter which direction you are traveling. Always be careful around children.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Keep right.
Keep left.
Pass with caution.
No passing.

questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: How should you avoid hitting vehicles in your blind spots?

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
Adjust your rearview mirrors every few minutes.
Honk your horn right before turning or changing lanes.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before turning or changing lanes, turn your head and look over your shoulder in the direction you are moving. This shows you what is in your blind spot. Do not rely on mirrors alone.

questions.question: What should you do when facing a car with bright headlights?

options.text: Use your high beams until the other driver dims theirs.
Flash your lights on and off to warn the other driver.
Dim your lights and speed up to pass quickly.
Look toward the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming car has its high beams on, look away from the lights and toward the right side of the road. This prevents you from being blinded by the headlights.

questions.question: Do pedestrians always have the right-of-way in crosswalks and at intersections?

options.text: True
False

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way when crossing at an intersection. A crosswalk exists at any intersection, whether it is marked or unmarked.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: Drive through the intersection if no traffic is coming.
Continue driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light marks a dangerous intersection. Treat it the same way you would treat a stop sign.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street but is not using its emergency lights or siren. What should you do?

options.text: Drive normally.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of its way.
Slow down, move to the right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you but not using its siren or flashing lights, you do not need to move. Continue driving normally.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean drivers cannot pass.

questions.question: Can you pass another vehicle when there are double solid yellow lines?

options.text: TRUE
FALSE

questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means no vehicle can cross it to pass, no matter which direction they are traveling.

questions.question: You are driving slowly and traffic is backing up behind you. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down more.
Pull off to the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
Do not let other cars pass.
Use your four-way flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off to the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic can be unsafe. On a two-lane road with traffic backing up behind you, pull off to the right and let the other vehicles pass. Only drive well below the speed limit when road conditions require it.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line dividing it. What does this tell you?

options.text: Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
This is a one-way road.
The road is being repaired.
You must stay to the left of the broken yellow lines.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you can cross it to pass slower traffic when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.
You must stop ahead.
Do not speed.
A traffic signal is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: A transit bus is signaling to return to the main road after stopping. What must you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to let the driver know you see them.
Move to the left lane.
Give them the right of way.
Speed up to pass the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give them the right of way.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus returning to the main road after stopping. Slow down, change lanes, or stop if needed to let the bus safely enter traffic.

questions.question: On long drives, how can you stay awake?

options.text: Turn on the car radio.
Drive more slowly.
Stop and rest regularly.
Move your eyes from side to side.

questions.explanation: Take regular breaks on long trips. Stop to rest and stretch your body, even if you do not feel tired yet.

questions.question: Driving at night with only parking lights is illegal.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive at night using only parking lights. You must use your headlights when driving in the dark.
